name: first date/can't relate
source:
You're going on a first date! Take it seriously!

first date/can't relate is a short rom-com visual novel about getting into character and going on dates.

[From [url=https://ub4q.itch.io/first-date]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你们要去第一次约会！认真对待！

《第一次约会/无法联系》是一部简短的浪漫喜剧视觉小说，讲述了如何进入角色并进行约会。

[来自[url=https://ub4q.itch.io/first-date]itch.io[/url]]
